reviews.text: I bought this based on Le Dahye's recommendation. My husband saw remarkable results after using it; his skin texture became noticeably smoother, the color more even, and his complexion was great, much like his natural skin. However, after using it, I couldn't see any difference except for the even color. Maybe it's because I don't have many blemishes to begin with! It's suitable for daily use, and it looks very natural, but remember to remove your makeup afterward!
reviews.zh: 我係聽咗 Le Dahye 推薦先買嘅。我老公用咗之後效果好明顯：皮膚紋理明顯滑咗，膚色更均勻，膚質好好，好似佢原本嘅皮膚咁。不過，我用咗之後，除咗膚色均勻之外，睇唔到有咩其他分別。可能係因為我本身冇咩瑕疵吧！日常用都啱，睇落好自然，不過記得之後要卸妝呀！

reviews.text: IN LOVE with. everything about this product, from texture to coverage and specially that glow and I mean that lit from within inner fairy glow. The only downside for me was the shade was a bit light on my light to medium skin tone but a little bit of bronzer fixed it right away and it was perfect. This is made for people who want an even skin tone with that no make up make up look.
reviews.zh: 超愛！呢款產品嘅一切我都好鍾意，由質地到遮瑕力都係，特別係嗰種光澤，我係指由內而外透出嚟嘅仙氣光感。唯一缺點係色號對我淺至中性嘅膚色嚟講偏淺咗少少，不過加少少古銅粉即刻就搞掂，效果好完美。呢款係為咗想要均勻膚色、又要「冇化妝感」嘅裸妝效果而設計嘅。

reviews.text:
It seems to be marketed for men, but as a woman in my 50s, I tried it and really love it.

It feels like I’m wearing no makeup at all. If you hate foundation settling into fine lines and wrinkles, give this a try!
reviews.zh:
睇落好似係針對男士推廣，不過我係五十幾歲嘅女士，試過之後好鍾意。

搽落去好似冇化妝咁。如果你好憎粉底卡入幼紋同皺紋，可以試吓！

reviews.text:
It is such an amazing product! For men and woman.
The color of it blends completely with the skin, so you enjoy the protection of the iron oxide, without the look of foundation or heavy coverage. 
It gives a gentle glow, the texture is super light and the packaging is very comfortable to use - clean and precise
reviews.zh:
真係好出色嘅產品！男女都適用。
佢嘅顏色同皮膚完全融合，所以你可以享受氧化鐵嘅防護，又唔會有粉底嘅感覺或者厚重嘅遮瑕。
佢會帶嚟溫和嘅光澤，質地好輕，包裝用起嚟好舒服——乾淨、精準。

reviews.text: finally i found a dream sunscreen!! It's so lightweight while giving you light coverage too. You totally can get away with this in your lazy makeup days, you don't even need puff / beauty sponge to blend this. Apply it just like you apply your sunscreen and your skin will look flawless and glowy. It comes out total white but as you rub it in to your skin, it will change and adapt colour to your skin.
reviews.zh: 終於搵到我嘅夢想防曬！！好輕，同時又有輕微遮瑕效果。懶得化妝嗰日用呢款都完全冇問題，連粉撲／美妝海綿都唔使，直接推開就得。同擦防曬一樣咁擦，皮膚就會好似無瑕又有光澤。擠出嚟係全白色，但係揉進皮膚之後，佢會變色、啱啱好貼合你嘅膚色。

reviews.text: With a subtle, skin-toned tint, this tone-up cream contains four colored particles—white, red, yellow, and black. No matter your skin tone, it precisely color-corrects and refines your complexion.
reviews.zh: 帶有淡淡嘅膚色色調，呢款提亮霜入面有四種顏色嘅粒子——白色、紅色、黃色同黑色。無論你膚色係咩，都可以精準調色、修飾膚色。

reviews.text: I’ve been using the OBgE natural cover lotion every morning and I really like how lightweight it feels on my skin.It blends in easily without stickiness and gives a subtle tone‑up effect that makes my face look a bit brighter and more even
reviews.zh: 我每朝都用緊 OBgE natural cover lotion，我真係好鍾意佢搽喺皮膚上嗰種輕盈感。好容易推開，唔會黏，有少少提亮效果，令我個面睇落亮少少、均勻少少。

reviews.text: used this as a sample and now got the full size, although it is marketed for men i use it as a woman and i am happy with the product for days i do not need a full face of foundation and just want some sun protection and coverage
reviews.zh: 之前用試用裝，而家買咗正裝。雖然係主打男士用嘅，但我以女士身份用，對呢款產品好滿意，適合唔需要全臉粉底、只想防曬同少少遮瑕嘅日子。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
